title: "Chapter 5 - Burning - Cochran-Armitage - By Tool Class - Axe"
output: word_document
date: "2026-07-14"
---

```{r}
# Load required package
library(DescTools)

# Load data
data <- read.csv("Burning Macro and Micro Data - Axe.csv")
```

```{r}
#Macro_Edge_1_Regularity
data$Time <- factor(data$Time,
                    levels = c(30, 45, 60, 75, 90),
                    ordered = TRUE)

Axe_Macro_Edge_1_Regularity <- xtabs(
  ~ Time + Macro_Edge_1_Regularity,
  data = data
)

addmargins(Axe_Macro_Edge_1_Regularity)

CochranArmitageTest(Axe_Macro_Edge_1_Regularity)
```
